Insulting and unscrupulous management
Jul 2020
Very good pizza and staff, however the management are the most insulting and unscrupulous I've ever spoken to. I was given a pasta with my pizzas, which I presumed was a complimentary item as their had been a disagreement over the phone regarding delivery fees being charged while being advertised as free on Vietnammm.com(they have called me before to notify me of delivery fees, though not with every order, sometimes it was free) I thought very highly of the business at this point as i was under the apprehension that they had addressed their miscommunication by giving a repeat customer a complimentary item. I ate some of this pasta but I do not like mushrooms, so majority of it was left when they called me around 25 minutes after the order had arrived to say there had been a mistake and could I return the pasta, not only was it cold already, but as I had eaten some of it, I said I could not return it. They then insisted that I pay for their mistake and send the driver to collect money for my barely touched unordered pasta. I refused this ridiculous offer and the manager became extremely aggressive and began shouting at me when I raised the point that not only was it poor customer service to charge me for their mistake, but to wait over 25 minutes to call me, and then expect to come and take the pasta from me and deliver it to another customer, very late, very cold and which had already been in a strangers hands. If i were the person who originally ordered the pasta and did not receive it, then received it later cold, and possibly soiled from another customer, I would be extremely shocked to discover this and would not hesitate to boycott the business in the near future. The worst thing is even though spaghetti with some mushrooms is extremely cheap to make, they are still insisting the driver pay for their mistake and using this to guilt trip me into paying for a pasta that I neither ordered, nor did anything other than pick some bits out of for curiousity. The manager was aghast when i raised these issues and decided to verbally abuse me saying how dare I speak to her like that, when I had been nothing but respectful when raising issues with their various infringements on customer service and food safety she then hung up on whilst me whilst shouting that they don't need customers like me, I have worked in restaurant and bar service for most of my life so I know what should and shouldn't be done and I always make an effort to be polite to all staff. Basically good pizza and friendly staff with an offensive, rude and unscrupulous manager.

Good Staple Pizza
Mar 2020
I decided to try 365 Degrees Pizzeria as a change from my usual pizza haunts. The staff were particularly friendly which made for a very pleasant experience. The Margarita pizza was definitely better than the average pizza in the city and deserved a Good rating. But the Trip Advisor ratings only allow for either an Average rating or Very Good and doesn't have a Good option. Therefore I have selected an Average rating as I felt the pizza leant more towards Average than Very Good. The base and crust were perfect and for me the right texture and very pleasant taste but the toppings were rather bland. I think the problem was the tomato base. If I hadn't seen the tomato base as I was eating I could quite easily have mistaken the pizza as a cheese only pizza as I didn't experience any of the taste of the tomato sauce. Because it was still a pleasant pizza I would definitely go back there but I would try a different pizza next time that is more dependent on the toppings for taste rather than the tomato sauce. The chili in oil, however, was superb. Truly spicy and flavorsome. It might well have been home made - a bottle of oil chock a block with chilis. That soon added a kick and taste to the pizza! I was craving french fries too but unfortunately the waitress told me that they had run out. So french fries and a different pizza next time but I definitely think this restaurant is worth visiting again.

Amazing vegan pizzas
Sep 2019 • Friends
Amazing VEGAN pizzas made with Kashew cheese! We’d been craving good pizzas after 4 months of noodles and rice in Asia and this place came through and then some!

It doesn’t come up on Grab for some reason so put the destination as Jive Yoga Studio by Suzanne Vian which is next door.

We ordered garlic & rosemary focaccia and two ‘pizza number 4’ (see menu pic) with pesto on the side. All of it was fresh, delicious and made with good quality ingredients. It was so nice to have ‘cheese’ for a change! They have great condiments too - quality olive oil, chilli oil, balsamic vinegar etc.

They also have amazing wine which we were pretty sure is vegan - it has a ‘V’ on the bottle and the wine itself wasn’t a clear red which suggests it hasn’t been clarified, although i can’t be certain.

We Whatsapped the restaurant ahead to check they definitely had vegan pizzas and they replied really quickly so we weren’t waiting around. When we arrived the staff were super friendly and helpful. They told us they’re working on a new vegan menu and also have 50% off vegan pizzas on Thursdays.

Great little Pizza and Pasta place
Mar 2017 • Couples
Just chanced upon this great liitle pizza place while walking around Thao Dien wondering where I was going to eat earlier this evening.
Located on a quiet back street it is very tiny place with only 4 or 5 tables, but has a cosy and homely ambiance. 
Service was quick, friendly and efficient. Menu was made up of mostly pasta, pizzas and salad.
Ordered the Margarita with artichoke chicken and italian sausage pizza and the baked cheese Gnocchi. 
Food was served quite quickly as there was only other table occupied. The thin and crispy pizza was a generous size, brick oven baked and just right for 2 people. Crispy on the outside crust and made even better accompanied with the homemade chilli olive oil. Taste was authentic Italian pizza and just right in the delicate flavours. 
The single portion of gnocchi was thoughtfully divided into two small individual claypot servings and arrived at the table with the cheese bubbling hot with some herbs sprinkled on top. Delicious taste and again not too salty as it sometimes can be. The Gnocchi texture and taste seemed genuinely homemade and was delightful. 
To accompany all this good food we had fresh coconut drinks which were served nice and cold.
After the meal i chatted with lady serving us and learned that she was the owner and operated the place together with her husband at this location for just over a year.
An overall positive food experience, price was very reasonable and i'm happy that I have discovered this place. They also do a motorbike delivery service.
I will definitely be going back soon.............
